title: Signed value of a query check
statement: Given a sign-valued Boolean function $f$ on the $n$-dimensional sign cube and a sign query check $C$, let $v$ be the randomized acceptance probability of $C$ when applied to the bounded real-valued cube function corresponding to $f$. The signed value of the check is $2v-1$.
